concept.title: Review History and Commits
concept.shortdesc: Explore the commit graph, inspect what each commit changed, and trace a line back to the commit that last touched it.

conbody.p: The view shows the commit graph, the details of any commit, and the files it changed. From there you can inspect and compare revisions, get a plain-language summary of a commit with AI, and see who last changed each line of a file.
